'''Grand Admiral Tsung Rtp:''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Tsung]]
* '''Published:''' 16 June 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif|label=Rescue The Princess}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 RTP Tsung LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Gotta get ready for Origins. I'm gonna go down, but I want to win at least one game.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 61 as published: the Characters header says 22 but the list has 24 (the two Fambaa are listed there).
* Posted 'Obi Wan's Saber' dested the Premiere Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; Jedi Saber dested Jedi Lightsaber; DS Plans dested Death Star Plans; LSRS dested Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout; Yavin4 Mass WR dested Yavin 4: Massassi War Room; DS- DBAY dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327.
* The red-card section mixes Interrupts and Effects; each is dested as posted. Civil Disorder is unmarked, so it is the printed card.

== Strategy ==

-Rescue Leia as fast as possible using 8d8.  If they are blockading at the D-bay just walk the droid past and deploy Jar Jar at the detention Corridor. Make sure you can send some expendable troops to fight your way back.

-Once she is back keep her in the War room draining for 2 every turn. Keep Deneb both with her so that all that will come from their force pile.

-This is the point where if they come after you, then attack with all you have. If they stay away spread and drain.

-Use Figrin D'an for small bits of retreival

-Get Han and a scout together to cancel BD's

-If you need to keep Your people from being battled at an interior site (a.k.a. Leia and Jar Jar at DS: DC waiting for reinforcements) the put them on one of the fambas.
